authorization: Build-time practical tolerance set to 10% before the first inferential look.
timing: Recorded after confirmatory collection started and before any confirmatory inferential look. Original 5% protocol is retained; this is an explicit post-start amendment, not the original preregistration.
selection_basis: Practical tolerance specified independently of confirmatory effect estimates and confidence intervals; first look selected from exact interval feasibility and paired collection waves.

unchanged.stop_rule: All72 treatment timing contrasts establish a nonzero median effect or equivalence within the registered margin; all12 A/A control intervals establish equivalence. Correctness/provenance gates must pass.

interpretation: 10% is the build practical-equivalence margin, not a claim of power or guaranteed precision at 14 observations. Retain runtime margin 3%, all platforms/levels/contrasts, alpha spending, all data and correctness/model-validity gates. If unresolved at 14, continue to 28, 56, and so on.
